An Ordinance to amend the Town of Pine Mountain Ordinance to Regulate and Tax Alcohol; to provide an effective date to repeal all ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith; and for other purposes.

WHEREAS, the Town of Pine Mountain adopted a comprehensive ordinance to regulate and tax alcohol, which was signed into law on October 12, 2020 (the “Alcohol Ordinance”); and

WHEREAS, on November 9, 2020, the Town of Pine Mountain amended the Alcohol Ordinance to expressly prohibit the home delivery of malt beverages, wine, and/or distilled spirits within the limits of the Town of Pine Mountain as provided for in Georgia House Bill 879;

WHEREAS, the Town of Pine Mountain desires to further amend the Alcohol Ordinance to remove any reference to off-premises liquor licensing and package stores, which are not authorized in the Town of Pine Mountain but were inadvertently included in the Alcohol Ordinance as adopted.

NOW THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, HARRIS COUNTY, GEORGIA, AND BY AUTHORITY OF THE SAME, IT IS HEREBY ORDAINED AS FOLLOWS:
1:
That Section 1(r) of the Alcohol Ordinance is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following language is inserted in lieu thereof:

- (r) Intentionally omitted.
2:
That Section 4(a)(3) of the Alcohol Ordinance is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following language is inserted in lieu thereof:

- (3) Intentionally omitted.
3: That Section 7(a) of the Alcohol Ordinance is hereby amended to delete the phrase “package liquor”.
4: That all ordinances or parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby expressly repealed.
5:
That this amendment shall become effective on June 14, 2021.

SO ORDAINED, this 14 day of June, 2021.

T. Pierce __, Councilperson
